hook: A U.S. military ISR aircraft operating over the Arabian Gulf observed two separate UAPs five minutes apart on November 2, 2020, both recorded via Full Motion Video (FMV) during a 20-hour-42-minute NAVCENT-supported reconnaissance mission monitoring Iranian naval and UAS activity.
why_it_matters: This document is notable for producing two distinct UAP observations within a single mission window, each independently logged as separate OBSERVATION entries with precise DTG, aircraft position, and heading data. The mission context — active surveillance of Iranian military vessels and drone activity in a contested maritime zone — adds operational weight to the sightings, as the crew was specifically trained and equipped to identify and characterize airborne and maritime objects. The FMV footage was subsequently exploited by DOSI, indicating the observations were treated as operationally significant beyond the initial report.

key_findings.finding: Two UAPs were observed five minutes apart at 2143Z and 2148Z via Full Motion Video (FMV), with the second UAP observed traveling northwest. Both observations were made from the same aircraft at FL220.

key_findings.finding: The FMV footage from the mission was exploited by DOSI, indicating that the UAP observations were reviewed and processed by an external imagery analysis entity beyond the reporting crew.

The aircraft was hailed on GUARD frequency by Iranian Air Defense at 1012Z during the mission and responded with standard protocols, confirming the aircraft was operating in or near Iranian-monitored airspace at the time of the UAP observations later that same mission.

key_findings.finding: Haze conditions formally precluded effective IMINT collection for the mission, yet both UAP observations were still captured via FMV, and the intel gap was recorded as unfilled — suggesting the UAPs did not resolve the mission's primary collection objectives.

legacy_program_connections.reasoning: This MISREP is an explicit UAP report filed through USCENTCOM to AARO via the standardized military UAP reporting chain, as described in the war.gov manifest.
The mission employed IMINT collection assets with FMV exploitation by DOSI, indicating involvement of imagery intelligence infrastructure that may intersect with national reconnaissance capabilities.
